description: Recent crypto and Web3 venture funding rounds (project, date, round type, amount and valuation in USD, lead and other investors, category, chains) from DefiLlama's public Raises page. Filter by date window, investor, category, chain, round or minimum amount. Amounts are as DefiLlama lists them and can be missing for undisclosed rounds; new rounds appear within days. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. DeFi, Infrastructure, Gaming

chain.description: Optional chain filter, e.g. Solana, Ethereum

days.description: Look back this many days, 1 to 365 (default 30). Ignored when since is given.

investor.description: Optional investor name filter (lead or other), e.g. a16z, Coinbase Ventures

round.description: Optional round filter, e.g. Seed, Series A, Strategic

name: crypto_crypto_fundraising_rounds
title: Crypto Crypto Fundraising Rounds
